paragraphs.text: Thirty-four of the stained-glass Planeswalker card styles introduced through the " War of the Spark Chronicles" campaign on Magic: The Gathering Arena feature flavor text not visible on the cards themselves, but in a separate pop-up box as part of the card's tooltips. The flavor text are primarily excerpts from Greg Weisman 's novel War of the Spark: Ravnica , though some are not directly attributed to the author. The balance are quotes from the characters themselves. These flavor texts are only visible on the stained-glass card style and are not visible on the regular or extended art versions of the card, nor are they listed on Scryfall .
Only two stained-glass Planeswalker cards, Liliana, Dreadhorde General and Jiang Yanggu, Wildcrafter , do not have any flavor text.
